UPDATE video v LEFT JOIN ( SELECT video_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM video_like GROUP BY video_id ) t ON v.id = t.video_id SET v.like_count = COALESCE(t.cnt, 0) WHERE v.like_count != COALESCE(t.cnt, 0) AND v.status = 2;

UPDATE video v LEFT JOIN ( SELECT video_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM video_favorite GROUP BY video_id ) t ON v.id = t.video_id SET v.favorite_count = COALESCE(t.cnt, 0) WHERE v.favorite_count != COALESCE(t.cnt, 0) AND v.status = 2;
